Alpha LLP.posture: Conservative. Risk-averse. Prefers mutual obligations, low caps, broad exit rights. Protecting downside is more important than winning the deal.

limitation_of_liability.position: Mutual cap at 1x fees paid in the prior 12 months. Exclude all consequential, indirect, and special damages.
limitation_of_liability.accept: 2x fees cap with carve-outs only for fraud and wilful misconduct.

indemnification.position: Mutual indemnification, limited to third-party claims. No indemnification for direct losses between the parties.
indemnification.accept: One-way indemnification favoring the client, but only for IP infringement.

termination.position: Either party may terminate for convenience on 30 days' written notice, with no penalty.
termination.accept: For convenience on 60 days' notice, with a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees.

confidentiality.position: Mutual confidentiality, 5-year term from disclosure. Return or destroy on request.
confidentiality.accept: 3-year term, with standard carve-outs for legal compulsion.

Beta Partners.posture: Commercial. Aggressive. Prefers one-way protections favoring the client, higher liability caps for counterparty exposure, harder exit provisions. Winning the deal is more important than minimizing downside.

limitation_of_liability.position: Cap at 3x fees paid in the prior 12 months. Carve-outs for IP infringement, data breach, and confidentiality breach — uncapped for those.
limitation_of_liability.accept: 2x cap with IP and data breach carve-outs only.

indemnification.position: One-way indemnification favoring the client, broad scope covering all third-party claims and regulatory actions.
indemnification.accept: One-way indemnification limited to IP infringement and data breach.

termination.position: Termination for cause only, with a 90-day cure period. No termination for convenience.
termination.accept: For convenience on 180 days' notice, with an early termination fee.

confidentiality.position: Perpetual for trade secrets. 3-year term for other confidential information. No return obligation if legally required to retain.
confidentiality.accept: 5-year term for trade secrets, 2-year term for other information.
